messages:
elena: Quick pollwe're iterating on a more compact left sidebar that groups by Workspace -> Resources. Two open questions: breadcrumb granularity (show Area vs skip to Item) and whether deep-links should preserve open/closed state of nav groups. Thoughts?

chris: I'm leaning to always show Area in the breadcrumb (Org > Workspace > Area > Item). Users rely on that context when they land from a link.

mike: Accessibility angle: if deep-link reopens a collapsed group, we must set focus to the newly revealed item and announce it. Avoid surprising keyboard users.

jia: Route idea: `/orgs/:orgId/w/:wsId/:area(models|endpoints|data)/:id` with optional query state for UI: `?panel=versions&nav_open=resources`. We'll keep canonical routes without nav_open and let shortlinks resolve to canonical + client replaceState to set nav UI.

tara: UX nit: when folks copy a link from the app, they expect it to bring them to the same visible UI. If we strip nav state from canonical route, consider a shortlink that encodes UI state but resolves to canonical; otherwise users get confused.

elena: Good point. Proposal: canonical routes are minimal (no nav UI state). Shortlink service supports encoding UI visibility for share intent only. Client resolves shortlink and then uses history.replaceState to set minimal UI state (no extra history entries).

chris: Also: breadcrumb labels must prefer human titles. Do not render internal slugs or ids. Use server-side metadata for crumb titles.

aria-bot: a11y-scan: missing skip-to-main on the compact preview. Contrast warning on collapsed nav hover in light theme. Filing A11Y-501.

mike: Add tests: e2e for deep-link open+focus, keyboard nav when group auto-expands, and screen-reader announcement of breadcrumb updates.

jia: Will draft route table + shortlink resolver behaviour doc. Plan to canary on staging for a week.

elena: Action items: jia route doc + shortlink example, mike a11y e2e plan + focus helper util, chris crumb copy rules, tara test shareflow. We'll reconvene after PR review.
